uncertainty_limit: Positive-ascertained annotated sORFs from one study; no independent population-sampling or biological-noise confidence interval inferred. Weak n=8 is descriptive.

input_only_overlap.scope: Input-only exact-window overlap with primary native TE cohort; not a TIS accuracy result
input_only_overlap.limits: A query may contain candidates matching several partitions; counts are not disjoint. TIS labels were not read. Window similarity outside exact equality is not certified.

native_TE_context_exposure.interpretation: TE training used response labels, not TIS labels; overlapping input sequences prevent a wholly unseen-sequence claim. These strata are descriptive, not alternative primary endpoints.
